briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.3%) with no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy, and letting existing positions ride.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on hand rather than invested, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Holding cash on a neutral day instead of forcing a purchase preserves flexibility and avoids buying into low-conviction setups.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者保留現金而非急於投資，以便在出現明確機會時迅速部署資金。在市況平淡的日子選擇持有現金而非勉強買入，有助保持靈活性，避免在信號不明確時貿然進場。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with the NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move, consistent with a broader consolidation phase after recent gains. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off signal, investors largely stayed on the sidelines.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平淡，缺乏明確方向，納斯達克指數下跌0.6%，標普500指數下跌0.3%。市場並無單一主導因素推動走勢，較符合近期升勢後的整固格局。由於未見明顯的風險偏好或避險訊號，投資者普遍選擇觀望。
